items.name: can
items.title: Can
items.description: Renders children when the signed-in session has a permission, otherwise the fallback.
items.docs: Use for a button or a field, not for a route. Props: permission, children, fallback (default null). Route access uses RequirePermission. The permission check is hasPermission from domain/user.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: The only form. Formik holds the draft, a Zod object schema parses one field, and onCommit receives the parsed value.
items.docs: Use for every form. Import Form from src/presentation/components/base/Form. Props: values (external draft), schema (Zod object), onCommit(path, parsedValue), onSubmit(), children(form). form.commit(path, raw) keeps the raw value locally and calls onCommit only when that field parses. form.error(path) is the message after the field is touched. form.submit() runs onSubmit. A later external snapshot updates keys that changed and leaves an invalid local value in place when that key did not change. The order page passes orchestrator.changeField as onCommit. Do not import formik or render <form> outside this file.

items.name: require-auth
items.title: RequireAuth
items.description: Route layout that sends an anonymous session to /login and keeps the attempted location.
items.docs: Use as a parent route, not inside a page section. While auth status is booting, it shows the loading line. When status is anon, it redirects to /login with the current location in state. Otherwise it renders the child route through Outlet.

items.name: require-permission
items.title: RequirePermission
items.description: Route layout that sends a session without the route permission to /forbidden.
items.docs: Use as a parent route under RequireAuth. Prop: permission (one permission or a list). While auth is booting, it shows the loading line. When canAccessRoute from domain/user rejects the session, it redirects to /forbidden. Otherwise it renders Outlet. A single control uses Can.

items.name: section-error-boundary
items.title: SectionErrorBoundary
items.description: Catches a crash in one page section and leaves the rest of the page up.
items.docs: Wrap one logical section. Props: label, children. The fallback is "{label} 区域加载失败，请刷新重试。" and the error is logged with that label. Do not wrap the whole page in a single boundary.
